case.title: inventory-api unreachable on its port
case.description: The inventory-api service does not answer requests from the dashboard proxy. Its health check has been failing since the last configuration change.

prior_turns.text: The inventory dashboard says the inventory-api service is unreachable. Can you look into it?

memory: inventory-api runs as a local service on this host and is configured in app/service.conf

workspace.content:
# service configuration
name = inventory-api
listen_port = 8081
log_file = app/logs/service.log

2026-10-14T08:00:01Z INFO  inventory-api starting
2026-10-14T08:00:02Z INFO  loaded app/service.conf
2026-10-14T08:00:03Z INFO  listening on :8081
2026-10-14T08:00:04Z ERROR upstream health check expects port 8080, service is listening on 8081

#!/bin/sh
# Passes only when the service listens on the port the upstream health check expects.
if grep -qx 'listen_port = 8080' app/service.conf 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "port ok"
  exit 0
fi
echo "port mismatch: app/service.conf does not listen on 8080"
exit 1

# inventory-api

inventory-api is a small HTTP service that answers inventory lookups for the warehouse dashboard. It runs on this
host, reads its settings from app/service.conf, and writes its logs to app/logs/service.log. Its upstream health
check is run by the dashboard proxy, which expects the service on the port listed in the proxy configuration.

user_message: The inventory-api service is unreachable. Find out why and fix it.

objective.goal: Make inventory-api listen on the port the upstream health check expects, so the service is reachable.
